Release notes for HC Studio version 2026.06.27.5:

- Agent Compatibility (Step 7): the DSPM + FDC section now shows a detected agent-version context card, just like the F1E DLP + Hybrid Web card. The FDC agent version is pulled automatically from the Step 6 Agent Management CSV (latest deployed, with host/online/offline/stale stats) or, if that's not imported, from the FDC + DSPM Agent installed version in Step 4 — Version & EoS.

For more details, please refer to the official documentation or contact support.
